page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.12xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each of the 48 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core, ensuring dedicated compute allocation without hyperthreading resource sharing.

The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for distributed environments.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer predictable performance for enterprise workloads. This configuration is suitable for general-purpose applications, web serving, application servers, and medium-sized databases that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core architectures.
